info.name: Aleph Alpha Document Index Collection API

params.name: namespace
params.description:
Namespace for collections of documents. Namespaces support preventing naming conflicts
for collections. A namespace typically corresponds to an organisation.
Namespaces may only contain alphanumeric characters (a-z, A-Z, -, . and 0-9) and
cannot be longer than 100 characters.

items.docs: List all collections that exist in the given namespace

params.description:

Namespaces may only contain alphanumeric characters (a-z, A-Z, -, . and 0-9) and

params.name: collection
params.description:
Collection containing documents. A search/lookup request always refers to a single collection, i.e.
only a single collection can be searched with a single search/lookup request. The name of the collection
must be unique within a namespace.
Collections may only contain alphanumeric characters (a-z, A-Z, -, . and 0-9) and cannot be longer
then 100 characters.

items.docs:
Creates a collection with a path given as namespace/collection.
Collections need to be created explicitly before documents can be put into a collection.

items.docs:
Deletes a collection identified by the namespace/collection.
If the delete request returns successfully, the collection is deleted, i.e. it cannot be found
any more neither by collection-path nor through search/lookup. However if the delete request fails
either deletion failed or the collection will be deleted eventually.

Gets count of all documents in a collection that are saved in the knowledge base, but not embedded for search yet.
The count is not exact but an upper boundary of the exact number of documents to be embedded.
